domain_restrictions: j is an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1
d is a real number with 0 <= d < 1/n (in particular, d is nonnegative)
the differentiability claim is for the function x maps to K_{n,j}(x) on the interval [0,d]
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive integers n, for all integers j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, for all real numbers d with 0 <= d < 1/n, the function x maps to K_{n,j}(x) has a derivative at every point x in the interval [0,d].
quantifier_order: for every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1
for every real d with 0 <= d < 1/n
for every x in [0,d] (interpreting differentiable on [0,d] pointwise)

variables.name: n
variables.role: index parameter for the family of functions K_{n,j}

variables.name: j
variables.role: index parameter constrained by 0 <= j <= n - 1

variables.name: d
variables.role: upper endpoint of the interval on which differentiability is asserted

variables.name: x
variables.role: input variable of the function K_{n,j}

statement_nl: For every positive integer n and every integer j with 0 ≤ j ≤ n - 1, and for every real d with 0 ≤ d < 1/n, the function x ↦ K_{n,j}(x) is differentiable on [0,d].
